high_level_description: This image is a promotional graphic for the Hollywood Creative Alliance Astra Award nomination for "Best Cast Ensemble" for the show "Saturday Night." The graphic features a stylized illustration of two characters from the show. People: On the left, there is a woman with shoulder-length wavy brown hair, wearing a light-colored top. She appears to be smiling or laughing. On the right, there is a man with short brown hair, wearing a suit and tie. He is holding a telephone receiver to his ear and appears to be speaking into it with an intense expression, possibly yelling or shouting. **
